items.title: Google Releases Emergency Chrome Update to Fix 10 Security Vulnerabilities
items.description: Google has released a critical security update for Chrome, pushing the Stable channel to version 145.0.7632.159/160 for Windows and Mac, and 145.0.7632.159 for Linux. The update addresses 10 security vulnerabilities, including three rated Critical, and is rolling out to users over the coming days and weeks. The release follows responsible disclosure from independent security researchers […] The…

items.title: Nation-State iOS Exploit Kit ‘Coruna’ Found Powering Global Attacks
items.description: Google and iVerify analysis reveals a powerful exploit kit originally used by Russian state actors that is now appearing in broader criminal campaigns. The post Nation-State iOS Exploit Kit ‘Coruna’ Found Powering Global Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.
